scenes.line1: How do you run apps in production?
scenes.say: Ever wonder how teams package, split, and secure apps in Kubernetes for production?

scenes.label: Charts
scenes.sub: Packages apps as charts with custom values.
scenes.say: Helm wraps your app into a chart, letting you customize settings for each environment.

rows.b: Split clusters by team or env

scenes.say: Namespaces split your cluster, so each team or environment stays separate and organized.
Role-based access control locks down who can do what, so only the right people have the right permissions.

scenes.question: How do you secure a Kubernetes cluster?
scenes.right: Use RBAC, namespaces, network policies, and trusted images.
scenes.say: If asked about security, don't just mention Helm and namespaces. RBAC, network policies, and trusted images matter too.
